note: Kinds of post, told apart by words in the caption (first match wins). A rough sort to see what mix the member posts and how each kind does for them; never a claim about what works for everyone.

kinds.label: Customer and proof
kinds.idea: A customer photo or a kind note you got (with their OK), and what they bought.

kinds.label: Event and local
kinds.idea: Where people can find you this week, with the day, time and place.

kinds.label: How-to and tips
kinds.idea: One useful thing your customers ask about, shown in under 30 seconds.

kinds.label: Behind the scenes
kinds.idea: How you make or do it, start to finish, with no cuts.

kinds.label: Product and offer
kinds.idea: One product or service, what it is, who it is for, and where to get it.
